gameDescriptionHtml:
What must a chef entrusted with starting a new restaurant in London do? That’s right, prepare a menu and come up with a name for the place. Except you’ve almost missed the deadline. Being out of ideas, you felt super-lucky to see an email offering to solve your exact problem. You clicked on the attached link, and then… Welcome to Wonderland’s one and only mobile cafe. A long journey awaits you in the unpleasant company of the smug Cat. Fingers crossed, you’ll find a way back home. But firstly, you have to feed the locals. Yet they are eccentric, capricious in their tastes, and tend to interfere in your cooking.

Game Features

  • FIND PROPER RECIPES FOR ORDERED DISHES. EACH VISITOR’S ORDER HAS A HINT ON WHAT INGREDIENTS AND TOOLS TO USE. THE REST IS UP TO YOU. EXPLORE.
  • SATISFY YOUR WEIRD VISITORS. A HUNGRY GUEST IS AN ANGRY GUEST.
  • MEET AND SERVE SPECIAL GUESTS WITH SPECIAL REQUESTS THAT YOU CAN FULFIL ONLY WITH CARDS RECEIVED FROM SATISFIED VISITORS.
  • MANAGE INGREDIENT STOCK: BUY MORE COOKING CARDS. SELL THE EVUESS AND GROW NEW INGREDIENTS BY PLANTING SEEDLINGS ON YOUR FARM.
  • UPGRADE YOUR DECKS OF COOKING CARDS AND TOOLS.
  • FEED BOSSES WITH UNBRIDLED APPETITES.
  • COMPLETE 25+ LEVELS WHERE YOU CAN EXPERIMENT WITH RECIPES, COOK MEALS YOU DREAMED OF, FROM SALADS TO FRIED DISHES.
  • COOK MORE. TO MEET TIMERS, AND FINALLY COME BACK TO LONDON WITH A PILE OF IDEAS FOR YOUR OWN MENU.
